title: Senior Azure Architect
description:
Alyra Technology

Intelligent Systems for Mid-Market Enterprises

Contract • 5–15 hrs/week • Must be located in Brazil

Please submit resumes in English.


﻿

About Alyra Technology

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for mid-sized businesses, with a focus on document-heavy, regulated environments. We combine modern Azure cloud architecture with applied generative AI to deliver systems that are explainable, auditable, and production-ready — not demos. Our work centers on extracting structure, meaning, and decisions from complex, unstructured documents at scale.


The Role

We are looking for a senior Azure architect with deep, hands-on expertise in applied generative AI systems — specifically systems that work with unstructured text, complex documents, and regulated data. This is not a role for someone who has experimented with LLMs on the side or bolted GPT onto a web app. We need someone who has spent years designing production GenAI systems that deal with messy, real-world documents: contracts, filings, medical records, policies, financial statements.

This role is architecture-first. You will turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries, and auditability strategies, primarily on Microsoft Azure.


What You’ll Do

Generative AI & Document Intelligence (Primary Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end GenAI systems for complex, unstructured document processing — including multi-format ingestion, layout-aware parsing, semantic chunking strategies, and document-grounded output generation.
  • Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that handle real-world document complexity: scanned PDFs, inconsistent formatting, multi-section contracts, tables, and cross-document reasoning.
  • Define strategies for extracting structured data and decisions from unstructured text, including entity extraction, clause detection, classification hierarchies, and confidence-scored outputs.
  • Architect multi-agent systems that go beyond single-prompt workflows, including agent routing and specialization, tool use, evidence retrieval, citation strategies, and step-by-step auditability.
  • Design evaluation and regression frameworks for GenAI outputs, including ground-truth datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and drift detection — so the system stays correct as models and data evolve.
  • Define prompt and behavior versioning strategies, human-in-the-loop review hooks, and hallucination mitigation patterns.


Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and validate usage of Azure AI services including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (vector + hybrid), Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Machine Learning.
  • Architect the broader platform stack: Azure Functions, App Services, Blob Storage and Data Lake, Azure SQL or Postgres, Entra ID, Key Vault, private endpoints, and networking boundaries.
  • Ensure all systems are observable, debuggable, and auditable by default — with logging, tracing, and cost instrumentation built in from day one.


Architecture & Design

  • Produce clear architecture diagrams — both logical and physical — covering ingestion pipelines, AI orchestration layers, storage and data lineage, security boundaries and RBAC, observability, and audit trails.
  • Make concrete tradeoffs around cost, latency, reliability, and explainability, and clearly explain those decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own ambiguous problems end-to-end and drive them to concrete, documented designs.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience designing and shipping production AI systems — not just evaluating or prototyping them.
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text: document parsing, information extraction, NLP pipelines, or document-centric AI applications. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven experience building production-grade RAG systems, multi-agent architectures, or document intelligence pipelines that handle real-world complexity.
  • Deep Azure platform experience — designing real systems end to end, not just deploying managed services.
  • Strong understanding of how GenAI systems fail in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context window limits, latency, and cost at scale.
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Strong communication skills: able to convey complex AI architecture through diagrams and written documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • 7+ years of total software or platform engineering experience.


Strongly Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with complex, multi-page document types: contracts, legal filings, medical records, financial statements, insurance forms, or regulatory submissions.
  • Experience with layout-aware document parsing tools (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, Unstructured, LayoutLM, or similar) and the architectural decisions around pre-processing pipelines.
  • Experience designing document-grounded output systems where every AI response is traceable to specific source passages or pages.
  • Prior consulting or client-facing architecture experience in a regulated domain such as insurance, legal, finance, or healthcare.
  • Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry as part of a broader workflow stack.
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code.


Values & Working Style

  • Hardworking and dependable: you do what you say you’ll do, and you finish.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Analista de Qualidade
description:
Quem é a Urbem ?

Unindo tecnologia e industrialização a uma matéria-prima renovável, trazemos para o Brasil a madeira engenheirada, alternativa construtiva que contribui para solucionar as dores da construção civil. Estamos falando de um canteiro de obras mais produtivo, previsível, sem geração de resíduos, mais rápido e seguro. Já pensou?


Somos a face de uma nova relação entre empresas, meio ambiente e pessoas. Com projetos íntegros, que nascem no campo e constroem nossas cidades.


Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão a partir de compromissos que impulsionam o desenvolvimento humano sustentável, a criatividade e a inovação.


Nosso ambiente é diverso, onde pessoas de todos os gêneros, raça, idade, orientação sexual e com deficiência escolhem para se desenvolver como pessoa e profissional.


O que esperamos de você?

Estamos em busca de pessoas para serem protagonistas de uma nova dinâmica que

conecta florestas a cidades. Que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Temos certeza que uma de nossas oportunidades vai dar um “match” com você!


Confira abaixo as as atividades que estão sob a responsabilidade da posição de Analista de Qualidade :

  • Realizar inspeções e acompanhamentos de qualidade em processos produtivos, materiais, produtos e serviços.
  • Monitorar padrões de qualidade, especificações técnicas, procedimentos internos e requisitos aplicáveis.
  • Identificar, registrar, analisar e tratar não conformidades, apoiando a definição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Apoiar a investigação de causas de desvios, falhas de processo, retrabalhos e reclamações de qualidade.
  • Elaborar, revisar e controlar procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, registros e documentos da qualidade.
  • Acompanhar indicadores da área, como não conformidades, retrabalho, refugo, eficiência e aderência aos padrões.
  • Atuar em conjunto com produção, processos, engenharia, PCP, manutenção e demais áreas para garantir conformidade e melhoria dos fluxos.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, bem como planos de ação decorrentes.
  • Promover a cultura da qualidade por meio de orientações, treinamentos e suporte às equipes operacionais.
  • Contribuir com projetos de melhoria contínua, padronização e aumento da confiabilidade dos processos produtivos.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Qualidade, Processos, Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com rotinas de qualidade em ambiente industrial.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas da qualidade, análise de causa, tratativa de não conformidades e elaboração de procedimentos.
  • Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenhos, especificações e processos produtivos será um diferencial.
  • Domínio de Excel e familiaridade com controles, indicadores e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Organização, planejamento e senso crítico.
  • Disposição para aprender e encarar desafios.


E aí, vamos construir as cidades do futuro, juntos?

Vem ser URBEM .

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Business-Content Writer - 2026
description:
BR SERVICES is looking for enthusiastic professionals with outstanding business-writing skills

If you have a strong written English level and want to work from the comfort of your home, this might be the right opportunity. Come and join our amazing team from all over the world!


We are a Brazilian company specializing in enterprise solutions that provides consulting services to clients globally. Our know-how ranges from management, information, technology, and finance. Our client’s vast business field will demand your curiosity and ability to research.  



MAIN TASKS


The main responsibility of the consultants is to produce the business narrative, that is, the descriptive content of Business Plans and other consultancy reports. In addition to being proficient in the grammar and rules of style of the American English, they should have strong writing skills, enabling them to express ideas elegantly and effectively.

The narrative aims to explain the Plan to the reader. Therefore, a Business Plan Document will typically describe the endeavor our client intends to launch, including the products the new company will sell, the region it will reach, the staff it will hire, etc. 


The Business-Content Writer Consultant will work in partnership with a financial consultant to produce and write Business Plans for our clients. These Plans are addressed to Government agencies and ultimately aim to obtain any type of business visa in the target country. Therefore, the following skills are essential:


  • Ability to understand our customer profile and business needs
  • Creative writing, with the ability to craft strategies and arguments, often with little background information.
  • Research relevant industry trends, trajectory, competition, the economics of targeted regions, and benchmark milestones;
  • Analyze the market strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats;
  • Connect and aggregate the ideas;
  • Rearrange them in a cohesive and clear text;
  • Proofread and ensure all-around consistency
  • Finally but not least, meet the deadline.


PROFILE AND COMPETENCIES

MANDATORY

  • >= 18 y. o.
  • Bachelor's degree 
  • Advanced proficiency in English;
  • Exceptional writing skills;
  • Advanced skills in MS Word (/compatible);
  • Beginner to intermediate skills in MS Excel;
  • Ability to meet deadlines;
  • Team-player mentality with excellent communication skills;
  • Passionate and curious with web surfer/effective search skills;
  • Attention to detail;


DESIRABLE

  • Intermediate to advanced skills in MS Excel
  • Intermediate skills in MS PowerPoint
  • Page/Graphic design capabilities
  • Studies in Marketing, Journalism, Letters, English

THE FIRM

BR SERVICES provides consulting services as well as document & linguistic solutions for customers such as companies in many industries, universities, or government agencies

Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, BR Services is incorporated with the company name of Lili Schneider Serviços Corporativos Ltda., under the Brazilian corporate taxpayer registry (CNPJ) N° / .


Our portfolio has solutions in two main Streams or Practices


1) CONSULTANCY PRACTICE

Our consultancy team provides business advice in areas such as management, information technology, and finance. Among the various products within the practice, Business Planning stands out as the flagship of the consultancy portfolio.


Our Business Plans chiefly focus on assessing and planning businesses to be established in the United States. They have swiftly become actual roadmaps to success for companies and entrepreneurs in their business expansion or their venture to enter a new business vertical. Our Plans have also served as a bridge to the US market for foreign investors, mostly from Brazil and other Latin American countries.


2) TRANSLATION AND LINGUISTICS PRACTICE


Based on our vast experience delivering premium translation, proofreading, copywriting, and ghostwriting services, we have acquired a solid reputation among corporate clients in Brazil and abroad.


On the other hand, our performance in this area is also specially acknowledged within academia. A reference in the translation of scientific papers, BR SERVICES is an accredited partner for scientific journals and maintains agreements for providing translation services with universities and other teaching institutions.


Our performance in this area is also highly recognized within academia. A reference in the translation of scientific papers, we are a certified partner for the edition, proofreading, and translation of their candidate articles. Moreover, we hold long-term agreements for supplying translation services to universities and other teaching institutions.

description:
Estamos em busca de um AI Engineer para atuar na evolução da plataforma, com foco na construção de sistemas inteligentes baseados em LLMs, agentes e bases de conhecimento.


Essa pessoa fará parte do time de engenharia e será responsável por desenvolver soluções de IA aplicadas ao produto, integrando modelos de linguagem com dados reais, sistemas internos e fluxos de negócio.


Nosso objetivo é construir uma plataforma orientada a inteligência artificial, com uso de RAG, agentes e múltiplas bases de conhecimento (relacionais, vetoriais e grafos), aplicadas a contextos educacionais e corporativos.


Não buscamos um perfil acadêmico ou focado em treinamento de modelos. Buscamos alguém que saiba transformar IA em produto real.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver funcionalidades baseadas em LLMs integradas à plataforma
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Estruturar e evoluir bases de conhecimento (dados estruturados, vetoriais e grafos)
  • Construir e orquestrar agentes e fluxos de execução (tools, multi-agents, etc.)
  • Integrar IA com sistemas existentes (APIs, banco de dados, serviços internos)
  • Trabalhar na qualidade das respostas (avaliação, melhoria contínua, contexto)
  • Otimizar custo, latência e performance das aplicações de IA
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia na evolução da arquitetura da plataforma


O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prática com uso de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • Experiência com construção de RAG e uso de embeddings
  • Experiência com integração de IA em aplicações reais (não apenas protótipos)
  • Conhecimento em APIs, backend e integração entre sistemas
  • Capacidade de estruturar e trabalhar com diferentes tipos de dados
  • Experiência com debugging e evolução de sistemas em produção
  • Mentalidade de engenharia (performance, custo, confiabilidade)


Stack e Tecnologias (IA e Dados):


  • LLMs e APIs de IA (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Bases vetoriais (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares)
  • Bases de grafos e conhecimento (Neo4j ou similares)
  • Orquestração de agentes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno ou abordagens próprias)
  • Integração com APIs e serviços internos
  • Backend para orquestração (Node.js, Python ou PHP)


O que é um diferencial:

  • Experiência com sistemas de múltiplos agentes (multi-agent systems)
  • Experiência com modelagem de conhecimento (ontologias, grafos, relações)
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados para IA
  • Experiência com avaliação e melhoria de respostas de LLM
  • Experiência com otimização de custo e performance em aplicações com IA
  • Experiência com produtos educacionais, LMS ou EdTe

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.
